name: Tickets, Please!
storyline:
After years of dreaming about life on the rails, you finally get your chance: your very own train, a handful of unpredictable passengers, and a route full of surprises. As the newest conductor of a once-forgotten railway line, it is your job to bring the train back to its former glory — one ticket, one repair, and one chaotic journey at a time.

Every trip brings a new mix of travelers: sleepy commuters, impatient tourists, confused stowaways, messy snack lovers, and passengers with very questionable excuses. Between checking tickets, cleaning up cabins, fixing broken equipment, and keeping everyone moving, your peaceful train ride can quickly turn into hilarious mayhem.

But the better you manage your train, the more it grows. Upgrade your carriages, improve comfort, unlock new tools, and turn your humble railway service into the coziest — and most chaotic — train line around.

On these rails, every stop tells a story. Keep the passengers happy, keep the train running, and remember: no matter how strange the journey gets, the next station is always waiting.
summary: Become a train conductor and run your own train in a relaxing cozy simulation! Check tickets, keep everything clean, repair faults, and upgrade your train. Experience humorous chaos on the rails in a laid-back yet hectic single-player adventure.
